arxiv-2012-06726.title: Models for the yielding behaviour of amorphous solids
arxiv-2012-06726.creator: Srikanth Sastry
arxiv-2012-06726.description: Abstract Understanding the mechanical response and failure of solids is of obvious importance in their use as structural materials. The nature of plastic deformation leading to yielding of amorphous solids has been vigorously pursued in recent years. Investigations employing both unidirectional and cyclic deformation protocols reveal a strong dependence of yielding behaviour on the degree of annealing.

arxiv-2101-09854.title: Redshift-space distortions with split densities 2020 Redshift-space distortions with split densities – References
arxiv-2101-09854.creator: Enrique Paillas, Yan-Chuan Cai, Nelson Padilla and Ariel G. Sánchez
arxiv-2101-09854.description: Abstract Accurate modelling of redshift-space distortions (RSD) is challenging in the non-linear regime for two-point statistics e.g. the two-point correlation function (2PCF). We take a different perspective to split the galaxy density field according to the local density, and cross-correlate those densities with the entire galaxy field.

arxiv-2201-10565.title: Using AGN lightcurves to map accretion disc temperature fluctuations 2022 Using AGN lightcurves to map accretion disc temperature fluctuations – References
arxiv-2201-10565.creator: J. M. M. Neustadt, C. S. Kochanek
arxiv-2201-10565.description: Abstract We introduce a new model for understanding AGN continuum variability. We start from a Shakura–Sunyaev thin accretion disc with a steady-state radial temperature profile T ⁡ ( R ) T(R) and assume that the variable flux is due to axisymmetric temperature perturbations δ ​ T ​ ( R , t ) \delta T(R,t) .

arxiv-2205-09130.title: Optical emission-line Luminosity Function models for populations of Supernova Remnants 2021 Optical emission-line Luminosity Function models for populations of Supernova Remnants – References
arxiv-2205-09130.creator: M. Kopsacheili, A. Zezas, I. Leonidaki
arxiv-2205-09130.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Kopsacheili, A. Zezas, I. Leonidaki. We present a basic model for the calculation of the luminosity distribution of supernova remnant populations. We construct theoretical H α \rm\alpha\, and joint [ S ii ] - H α \rm\alpha\, luminosity functions for supernova remnants by combining prescriptions from a basic evolution model that provides the shock velocity and radius for SNRs of different age and pre-shock density, with shock excitation models that give the gas emissivity for shocks of different physical parameters.

arxiv-2310-19385.title: Gradient-free online learning of subgrid-scale dynamics with neural emulators https://hrkz.github.com
arxiv-2310-19385.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a generic algorithm to train machine learning-based subgrid parametrizations online, i.e., with a posteriori loss functions, but for non-differentiable numerical solvers. The proposed approach leverages a neural emulator to approximate the reduced state-space solver, which is then used to allow gradient propagation through temporal integration steps.

arxiv-2406-14498.title: LLaSA: A Sensor-Aware LLM for Natural Language Reasoning of Human Activity from IMU Data
arxiv-2406-14498.creator: Sheikh Asif Imran Shouborno, Mohammad Nur Hossain Khan, Subrata Biswas, Bashima Islam
arxiv-2406-14498.description: Abstract . Wearable systems can recognize activities from IMU data but often fail to explain their underlying causes or contextual significance. To address this limitation, we introduce two large-scale resources: SensorCap , comprising 35,960 IMU–caption pairs, and OpenSQA , with 199,701 question–answer pairs designed for causal and explanatory reasoning.

arxiv-2409-13441.title: Searching For JWST’s Little Red Dots
arxiv-2409-13441.creator: John A. Regan
arxiv-2409-13441.description: Abstract Recent observations by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) have revealed a previously hidden population of extremely bright and compact objects between redshifts of z ∼ 4 z\sim 4 and z ∼ 10 z\sim 10 . Given their extreme red colouring in the observed frame these galaxies have been dubbed Little Red Dots (LRDs).

arxiv-2412-14765.title: Asymptotic invariants of residually finite just infinite groups Dedicated to the memory of Nikolay A. Vavilov
arxiv-2412-14765.creator: Andrei Jaikin-Zapirain, Steffen Kionke
arxiv-2412-14765.description: Abstract . Recently, Eduard Schesler and the second author constructed examples of finitely generated residually finite, hereditarily just infinite groups with positive first L 2 L^{2} -Betti number. In contrast to their result, we show that a finitely generated residually- p p just infinite group has trivial first L 2 L^{2} -Betti number.

arxiv-2505-12270.title: Arithmetic properties of ( ℓ , m ) (\ell,m) -regular colored partitions
arxiv-2505-12270.creator: Yashas N., C. Shivashankar and S. Chandankumar
arxiv-2505-12270.description: Abstract . Let b ℓ , m k ​ ( n ) b^{k}_{\ell,m}(n) denotes the number of k − k- colored partitions of n n into parts that are not multiples of ℓ \ell or m m . We establish several congruence relations for b ℓ , m ​ ( n ) b_{\ell,m}(n) .

arxiv-2505-17116.title: Comparative Evaluation of Prompting and Fine-Tuning for Applying Large Language Models to Grid-Structured Geospatial Data
arxiv-2505-17116.creator: Akash Dhruv, Yangxinyu Xie, Jordan Branham, Tanwi Mallick
arxiv-2505-17116.description: Abstract This paper presents a comparative study of large language models (LLMs) in interpreting grid-structured geospatial data. We evaluate the performance of a base model through structured prompting and contrast it with a fine-tuned variant trained on a dataset of user-assistant interactions.

arxiv-2602-13310.title: Visual Para-Thinker: Divide-and-Conquer Reasoning for Visual Comprehension
arxiv-2602-13310.creator: Haoran Xu, Hongyu Wang, Jiaze Li, Shunpeng Chen, Zizhao Tong, Jianzhong Ju, Zhenbo Luo, Jian Luan
arxiv-2602-13310.description: Abstract Existing LLM test-time scaling laws emphasize the emergence of self-reflective behaviors through extended reasoning length. Nevertheless, this vertical scaling strategy often encounters plateaus in exploration as the model becomes locked into specific thinking pattern. By shifting from depth to parallelism, parallel thinking mitigates the narrowing of exploration.

pmc-10618465.creator: Natkrittaya Saengsawang, Panthita Ruang-areerate, Nuanlaong Kaeothaisong, Saovanee Leelayoova, Mathirut Mungthin, Piraporn Juntanawiwat, Patomroek Hanyanunt, Patsanun Potisuwan, Piyanate Kesakomol, Pornphan Butsararattanagomen, Pattarawadee Wichaiwong, Wijitar Dungchai, Toon Ruang-areerate
pmc-10618465.description: Uropathogenic Escherichia coli (UPEC) causes up to 90% of urinary tract infections (UTI) which is more prevalent among females than males. In urine, patients with symptomatic UTI usually have a high concentration of bacterial infection, ≥ 105 colony-forming units (CFU) per mL, in which the culture method is regularly the gold standard diagnosis.

pmc-12409100.title: X‐ray multimeter performance under calibration laboratory conditions
pmc-12409100.creator: John T Stasko, Wesley S Culberson
pmc-12409100.description: BackgroundEstimating dose delivered to patients for a typical mammographic or radiologic examination requires accurate knowledge of several beam quantities. X‐ray multimeters (XMMs) are compact, solid‐state semiconductor dosimeters that have become common for conventional QA measurements due to their ease of use.

pmc-12667555.title: Acute Hepatitis A With Polyserositis and Acalculous Cholecystitis in an Adult: A Case Report
pmc-12667555.creator: Syed Faraz Abbas, Vaibhav Shukla, Saboor Mateen, Firdaus Jabeen, Ajay Singh Yadav
pmc-12667555.description: Hepatitis A virus (HAV) infection in adults is usually self-limited, yet atypical extrahepatic features may complicate the course. We report a 20-year-old male with fever, jaundice, and moderate ascites. Evaluation showed marked hepatocellular injury with direct-predominant hyperbilirubinemia and positive HAV IgM.

pmc-13301027.title: Small-for-Gestational-Age Status and Adverse Clinical Outcomes in Preterm and Very Preterm Infants: A Propensity Score-Matched Cohort Study
pmc-13301027.creator: Manapat Praditaukrit, Anucha Thatrimontrichai, Praew Chareesri, Pattima Pakhathirathien, Gunlawadee Maneenil, Supaporn Dissaneevate
pmc-13301027.description: Background/Objectives: Preterm (<37 weeks) and very preterm (<32 weeks) infants face considerably higher mortality and morbidity rates than full-term infants. We compared clinical outcomes between small-for-gestational-age (SGA) and appropriate-for-gestational-age (AGA) preterm infants. Methods: This retrospective cohort study used a prospectively collected database, obtained from 2014 to 2025.

pmc-13335503.title: Phase Fraction Modulation Enhances Li+/Na+ Diffusion Disparity in Spent LiFePO4 Cathodes for Efficient Lithium Extraction from Brine
pmc-13335503.creator: Ruiqi Yin, Qihan Huang, Jiayu Hao, Guosheng Li, Guoxing Ren, Dongfu Liu, Zhongwei Zhao, Wenhua Xu
pmc-13335503.description: Traditional spent LiFePO4 (SLFP) recycling faces challenges such as high energy consumption, environmental pollution, and low profitability. A novel direct cascaded utilization strategy was proposed for SLFP, where phase fraction modulation in the SLFP lattice enabled efficient lithium extraction from secondary‐treated lithium‐containing brine.
